The '''Anthus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anthus]].
